info.name: Hustle Public Access Token Tags API

params.name: name
params.description: Tag name. This is not a partial or fuzzy match but looks for an exact match of the tag name.

params.name: agentVisibility
params.description:
The context in which an agent can see and collect tags. 
LEAD_PROFILES: Agents will be able to see these while sending messages and use them to collect info about contacts. 
OPT_OUT: Specifically for opt-out reasons. Will only be displayed when agents opt out a contact. 
NEVER: Only for admins. Agents will never see this tag.

params.name: cursor
params.description: Cursor for start of next set of items. Pass whatever you receive from the response to get the next elements in the array.

items.docs: Get a list of tags scoped by query parameters.
